<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;

class DiagnosticsController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Run network diagnostics for internal service health checks.
     * This endpoint is used by the SRE team to verify connectivity
     * between microservices in the mesh.
     */
    public function pingCheck(Request $request)
    {
        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'target_host' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'timeout' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:30',
            'count' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:10',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => $validator->errors()], 422);
        }

        $host = $request->input('target_host');
        $timeout = $request->input('timeout', 5);
        $count = $request->input('count', 3);

        // Sanitize: strip obvious shell metacharacters but allow hostnames/IPs
        $host = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9\.\-\:]/', '', $host);

        // Additional check: must look like valid hostname or IP
        if (!filter_var($host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP) && !preg_match('/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-\.]+[a-z0-9]$/i', $host)) {
            Log::warning('DiagnosticsController: Invalid host format', ['host' => $host]);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid host format'], 400);
        }

        $command = sprintf(
            'ping -c %d -W %d %s 2>&1',
            (int)$count,
            (int)$timeout,
            $host
        );

        Log::info('DiagnosticsController: Executing ping', ['command' => $command]);

        $output = shell_exec($command);

        return response()->json([
            'host' => $host,
            'result' => $output,
            'timestamp' => now()->toIso8601String(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Trace route to target for debugging network path issues.
     * Accepts raw target to support IPv6 and complex internal DNS names.
     */
    public function traceRoute(Request $request)
    {
        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'target' => 'required|string|max:512',
            'max_hops' => 'nullable|integer|min:1|max:64',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => $validator->errors()], 422);
        }

        $target = $request->input('target');
        $maxHops = $request->input('max_hops', 30);

        // Build traceroute command - target is passed through for flexibility
        // with internal service discovery names (e.g., service.namespace.svc.cluster.local)
        $command = "traceroute -m {$maxHops} {$target} 2>&1";

        Log::info('DiagnosticsController: Executing traceroute', [
            'target' => $target,
            'max_hops' => $maxHops
        ]);

        $output = shell_exec($command);

        return response()->json([
            'target' => $target,
            'max_hops' => $maxHops,
            'trace' => $output,
            'timestamp' => now()->toIso8601String(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * DNS lookup for internal service resolution debugging.
     */
    public function dnsLookup(Request $request)
    {
        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'domain' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'record_type' => 'nullable|string|in:A,AAAA,CNAME,MX,TXT,SRV',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => $validator->errors()], 422);
        }

        $domain = $request->input('domain');
        $type = $request->input('record_type', 'A');

        // Use PHP's built-in DNS functions (safe)
        $records = dns_get_record($domain, $this->mapRecordType($type));

        return response()->json([
            'domain' => $domain,
            'type' => $type,
            'records' => $records,
            'timestamp' => now()->toIso8601String(),
        ]);
    }

    private function mapRecordType(string $type): int
    {
        return match($type) {
            'A' => DNS_A,
            'AAAA' => DNS_AAAA,
            'CNAME' => DNS_CNAME,
            'MX' => DNS_MX,
            'TXT' => DNS_TXT,
            'SRV' => DNS_SRV,
            default => DNS_A,
        };
    }
}
